skill.name: powerpoint-playbooks
skill.description: Use when the user asks what Manus can do with PowerPoint, WPS Presentation, or LibreOffice Impress, or needs a presentation workflow routed by the presentation state that must survive. Covers creation and editing, templates, masters, motion and media, slide organization, conversion, repair, and instruction; routes generic deck work to the presentation runtime or Slides and app-specific state to the exact installed or web presentation app only after capability and runtime checks.
skill.userDescription: Create, edit, repair, convert, and deliver presentation decks.
exampleQuestions: Create a PowerPoint deck outline for a product launch.
Help me repair formatting in this presentation.
Plan a reusable PowerPoint template with slide masters.
